title: Rent-to-Own Stores Charge 311% — Legal Loan Sharking
hook: You walked in for a $499 TV and agreed to pay $1,554. Rent-to-own is the most expensive legal purchase in America — and they design every contract to hide it.
angle: Most people think rent-to-own is a budget-friendly option for people who can't afford things upfront. It's actually one of the most predatory financial products ever sold — with effective APRs above 183% and early buyout prices still 80% over retail. There's no good deal anywhere in the contract.
audience: Anyone living paycheck to paycheck who's been inside or tempted by rent-to-own stores
key_numbers: 311% of retail price at full term
80% above retail even on early buyout
